annotations.title: Open a song in the studio

description: Opens the Bandmixr studio for a song in the chat. It shows what the song needs next: the upload box for stems, the label check (only the person can confirm labels there), the mix progress, or the player with the original, the mix and the master.

songId.description: The song id from list_songs or create_song.
